Full native runs use the final complete package.

qualifications: Two separate sequential 700-tic sprite/model pairs, one visible creature each and a Mandinga control. Queue intervals are not GPU/display timing, repeatability or campaign/crowd acceptance.
Original billboard and neutral-height-fitted model can occupy different screen areas. This comparison is not an equal-pixel-cost benchmark.
Candidate anatomy, material seams, costume details and articulation require author review; no exact sculpt or final-art acceptance claim.
